title: Find Users with Persistent Behavior Patterns
summary: Find runs of at least five consecutive dates on which a user performs exactly one action and that action is constant; for each user choose the longest run, then lexicographically smallest action, then latest start date; return user_id, action, streak_length, start_date, end_date sorted by length descending then user_id ascending.
inputFormat: activity(user_id int, action_date date, action varchar); primary key (user_id, action_date, action).
outputFormat: Columns: user_id, action, streak_length, start_date, end_date. One row per qualifying user. Ordered by streak_length descending, then user_id ascending.
officialConstraints: Schema types as above; action_date values are calendar dates. Other bounds: unknown.
tieRules: Per user: longest qualifying run first; then lexicographically smallest action; then latest start date (as the statement says).
edgeRules: A date with more than one action row for the user breaks a run. A run is consecutive calendar dates (day gap of exactly 1) with the same single action. Only runs of length 5 or more qualify.
exampleStatus: reference-only (user paste); not for publication; authored examples to be written for the website
